tank_description: An Attacker built around remaining hidden until the perfect moment to strike. A unique cloaking ability sets the Leo2KST as the foremost predator of the battle. This Attacker is ‘Stealth Personified’ unleashing devastating firepower on unsuspecting enemies before disappearing back into the environment, ready to hunt its next target.

strengths.title: HEAT Rounds
strengths.description: Thanks to the 2K-ST's HEAT equipped main gun there is very few situations where it will not be effective. With limited damage drop-off over long distances to close range knife fights this gun is capable of carrying you through any situation. Favourable handling and accuracy also contribute to make this weapon equally as effective at quick shots.

strengths.title: Stealth Capability
strengths.description: The 2KST is unique in that it features the ability to cloak itself from view for a limited time. Players with patience and a good ability to read the flow of a fight can use this to great effect and catch several opponents unaware and punishing reckless advances without giving your opponents any time to react and swinging any engagement to your favour.

strengths.title: Strong Mobility
strengths.description: Whilst not as fast as its sister tank, the 2KST is no slouch in its own right. Players will generally find little issue in relocating around the map, especially aided by its ability to cloak when needed. Crafty 2KST players will find plenty of opportunity for unexpected flanks, angles and other opportunities to make life difficult for your enemies.

weaknesses.title: Token Armour
weaknesses.description: The 2KST shares a similar profile as other Leo versions. It's armour is poor to the point of being almost non-existent to anything but the lightest of weapons. Coupled with an exposed frontal ammorack that is easy to hit means that in most cases, if engaged, you will take heavy damage with little in the way of mitigation.

weaknesses.title: Low HP Pool
weaknesses.description: The 2KST stands at the bottom of the pack at 2050 HP. Your staying power in direct combat suffers as a result. If a commander of the 2KST finds themselves the target of choice it will be a very quick ride back to respawn. This relegates the 2KST to second line support at best and limits its ability to strike out on its own.

weaknesses.title: Long Interclip Reload
weaknesses.description: A poor interclip reload stunts the otherwise impressive DPM potential of this vehicle. Once a player has expended their initial rounds they will find themselves without a main gun for a considerable length of time. If they fair to kill their enemy, especially if caught in CQB this is almost a guaranteed trip back to respawn.

tank_summary: The Leo 2KST is a stealth-focused Marksman that excels at striking from concealment before disappearing back into its surroundings. Equipped with advanced camouflage capabilities and a hard-hitting cannon, it punishes unaware enemies with devastating precision while remaining difficult to detect.

Unlike traditional frontline tanks, the 2KST relies on positioning and patience rather than armor. Its ability to blend into the environment allows skilled commanders to set up deadly ambushes, but being spotted at the wrong time can quickly turn the tide against it.

The Leo 2KST rewards methodical, calculated gameplay. Choosing the perfect moment to reveal yourself, deliver a high-impact shot, and relocate before the enemy can respond is the key to mastering this elusive predator.
